goal: Update .claude/commands/audit-phase.md to re-derive the loop-path marker from the archived phase's diff and emit a finding when a loop-path diff was archived with neither a DONE in-loop-verification task nor an opt-out, or when an opt-out claims no new path over a diff that in fact added a watched symbol.

references: Spec FR-6 (a/b) -- the two findings the audit must produce.

The phase's .loop-base file travels into archive/ with the phase (phase-base-diff), so the audit re-derives the marker from `git diff <.loop-base> HEAD` over the archived diff using flywheel.loop_path_marker.
flywheel.workflow opt-out loader -- how the audit locates and reads the opt-out to re-check its claim.
constraints: Instruct the audit to mechanically re-derive the marker by running flywheel.loop_path_marker against the phase's recorded-base diff -- not by prose guessing.
Emit FR-6a (loop-path diff archived with no verify task and no opt-out) and FR-6b (opt-out over a diff that added a watched symbol) as distinct findings.
Acceptance to encode: a mis-tagged opt-out over a diff that adds a Status member yields a finding; a correct opt-out over a pure refactor does not.
Be concise -- engineers scan; no emojis.
Commit the change with a Conventional Commits message (docs: ...) before emitting intent=verify.
non_goals: Do not change the gate's blocking behavior (the audit is the coverage check on the trigger, not the guarantee).
Do not retroactively gate already-archived phases beyond emitting findings.
